name: ONE ARM DUMBBELL LATERAL RAISE RIGHT
introduce: Hold a dumbbell in your right hand. Grab a doorway or something similar with your left hand. \n\nExtend your left arm and tilt your body slightly to the right. Raise your right arm to your right side at shoulder height, then lower it. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a doorway.
Keep your arm straight during the exercise.
Exhale as you raise your arm, and inhale as you lower it.
